name: fidacy
description: Firewall for AI agents. Watches every action the agent takes, ends each session in a digest anyone can recompute, and blocks the wrong money-moving action before it settles. Commands, paths and arguments never leave your machine.

plugins.name: fidacy
plugins.description: Wires the observer into Claude Code's hooks, so every tool call is counted locally and the session ends in a verifiable digest. Ships the @fidacy/mcp server (assess_action, request_payment, verify_mandate, anchor_artifact, get_audit_proof) and two skills. Free, local-first, deny-by-default, non-custodial.
